entities.summary: Reginald Rodrigues, also known as Reg Rodricks was an Indian field hockey player who competed in the 1948 Summer Olympics for the Indian gold medal-winning team. India had just gained its independence from Great Britain. He died on 15 August 1995 at the age of 73.
